summary: The fractal-ui kit adds an interactive QuestionForm for harness asks: radio and checkbox options, an automatic Other row, per-question notes, Recommended badges, markdown option previews, a tab strip with answered markers that stacks below 600 px, and keyboard answering (arrows, 1-9, Tab, Enter). It ships with an Explore story.

compatibility.detail: Additive kit export. The props mirror the question model on the pending question-forms app branch; the application has no question renderer yet and nothing on main uses the form.
